Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Rhodes Chaise Lounge Chair
Colors: Black
Materials: Aluminum
Chaise lounge chair for outdoor use; all-weather cushion with fabric ties to secure to frame Durable cast-aluminum frame with black powder-coat finish; 100-percent polyester cushion cover No assembly required; imported; coordinates with other pieces from the Rhodes collection (sold separately) Spot clean cushion; cover/store during inclement weather Measures 75.2 inches long by 27 inches wide by 36.4 inches high
